title: Vibeprint: how does an iPad sketch survive a page reload?
scope: Same-Wi-Fi link only (--no-relay or LAN URL): page reload, token cookie, WS snapshot, ink ops, canvas.json load/save.
omissions: Default hosted relay link (QR uses it when up), MCP, AI, git commits
Marks/chat/graph files, pasted images, other clients' live ops

groups.label: iPad
groups.description: Same Wi-Fi; holds HttpOnly token cookie

nodes.label: iPad browser
nodes.description: Draws ink; unacked ops in page memory only

nodes.label: vibeprint serve
nodes.description: Token-gated; acks ops in memory, saves later

nodes.label: canvas.json
nodes.description: Read only at start; unparseable JSON aborts

notes.title: Acked is not saved
notes.text: Ack means daemon memory only. canvas.json is rewritten (temp file + rename) after 800ms with no op from any client, or on SIGINT/SIGTERM; a crash loses acked edits since the last pause.

notes.title: Reconnect replays; reload drops
notes.text: Unacked ops live only in page memory: a reconnect (500ms–10s backoff) replays them on a fresh snapshot; a full reload loses them. Rejected ops (invalid/full) drop; page resnapshots.

notes.title: Token gate on reload
notes.text: / needs no token; /api/config and /api/canvas WS need the ?t= link's 1-year HttpOnly cookie (token kept across restarts). Without it: 401, fixed 'needs the link' page, no retry.
